# Interview Sarthi

> Three tools for one job hunt in India, all running on the job seeker's own free Google Gemini API key rather than our servers: ApplySarthi finds jobs and fills applications, Prep Sarthi runs voice mock interviews from your CV, and Interview Sarthi gives live help during the real interview. Built and run by one developer, Abhishek Choudhary, in New Delhi. Prices are in rupees.

Every page below is plain HTML with no JavaScript needed to read it. Facts pages carry review dates and a corrections address.

## The three products

- [Interview Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/): Windows app. During a live online interview it hears the interviewer through the meeting audio and drafts an answer from your resume in English, Hindi or Hinglish, on an overlay that screen sharing does not capture. 30 minutes free, then one-time passes from Rs 99 for 2 days. Microsoft Store and direct download.
- [Prep Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/mock/): Web app, works on phones. An AI interviewer reads your CV, asks about your own projects out loud, follows up when an answer is vague, then scores every answer and writes a stronger version of each. Any language. 20 minutes free, then one-time passes of Rs 99 for 7 days or Rs 249 for 30 days.
- [ApplySarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/): Web app plus a Chrome extension. Ranks open jobs from Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed and 750+ company career pages against your CV, tailors the CV to each job and fills the application form in your own browser for you to check and submit. Free in early access.
